title: Start of Day 1... Again!
author: JustANerd420
selftext:
So, I was making an application before and I accidentally deleted my files. So I had to start again, and I am looking to make backups, just trying to find the right provider (not GitHub).

Enough of my troubles, but today I have been hard at work all day long. I have been working with GLM 5.1 through Nvidia and I actually have something working this time around. I fill like there is really no Daily limit on Nvidia models. It's free to sign up and get an API key: https://build.nvidia.com/. They have quite a few models and might be useful for some of your video game making.

The pixel art was created by Gemma4 31B, through Google API. I have a few more things to work on, but I will have a free demo out soon on itch. After that I will continue working on the rest to get it out.

comments.author: JustANerd420
comments.body:
Can anyone think of anything they would like to see in an AI Pixel Art making program? Here is what I already planned:

\- User editing of AI generated assets  
\- Playground (load in assets to try out the different animations)  
\- Palette (Area to create palettes the AI will use for generation)  
\- Gallery (Saved pixel art inside the program)  
\- Sprite Sheet (Way to make sprite sheets and export right in the program)
